**STOP: round 507 needs a ruling from B.** The code-reviewer found one Medium, and I can't fix it within the grants, so the round is not complete.

**Applied:** B's sketch v2 applied cleanly (its sha256 matches). The four granted files are in the tree exactly as B wrote them:
- `app/components/audio/AudioPlayer.tsx`: Close, Previous, Next and Mute/Unmute now use `IconButton` ghost;
- `docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`: one ghost paragraph;
- `app/lib/__tests__/store-button-cleanup-n1.test.tsx` (new);
- doc 328 (new).

Frozen checks 1–4 are rc 0 before applying, after applying and at the end. `git status` shows only those four paths, and no protected file changed.

**Checks run, all matching B's §3 values:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck | rc 0 |
| lint | rc 0, 175 warnings |
| Biome on the two code files | rc 0, 1 warning (Play's missing `type`, already ruled out of scope) |
| Covering tests | 8 files, 86/86, rows N1-1 to N1-5 present |

The slowest covering test is LT7 at 763 ms. That is under the 2,500 ms limit but above the 444 ms B recorded, which I noted for B.

**Why it stopped (A-R507-CR-1-N1-2-SWAP-MUTANT, Medium):** N1-2 clicks all four controls before it asserts anything, and only checks that each action ran once. So swapping the Previous and Next handlers still passes the test. I proved it: with that swap the test file stayed green, 5/5. I then restored the file and check 4 was rc 0 again. The player's handlers themselves are correct; the gap is in the test. Fixing it would change the test's bytes and break check 4, which pins the four files to the sketch, so B needs to rule.
- I wrote a proposed fix in `a-round-507/proposed-n1-2-fix.diff.txt`. It is not applied and not run; I only expect, without having seen it, that the swap mutant turns red under it.
- Also for B: three Lows from the review (A-R507-CR-2 to -4), the review's architecture note (keep, nothing to extract), and what the lessons file says doc 328 line 4 must say if the round is re-dispatched.

**Not run:** the full test suite and the build (left to the root gate), and any browser check (that is C's). I mark no browser acceptance row as passed.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-507.md`, with the logs in `a-round-507/`.
